cases.title: ValueError: I/O operation on closed file in testing
cases.issue: Bug: using click.testing.CliRunner to invoke a command can raise ValueError: I/O operation on closed file. Traceback (most recent call last): File 'click/testing.py', line 299, in invoke: output = out.getvalue() ValueError: I/O operation on closed file. The finally block in CliRunner.invoke in click/testing.py calls getvalue() on a stream that was already closed.

cases.title: flask.abort() behavioral change in debug mode
cases.issue: Bug: calling flask.abort(400) inside a view behaves differently with debug=True; the HTTP exception is re-raised instead of returning an error response. Traceback (most recent call last): File 'flask/app.py', line 2287, in wsgi_app: response = self.handle_exception(e). File 'flask/app.py', line 1733, in handle_exception: server_error = self.ensure_sync(self.handle_user_exception)(e). File 'flask/app.py', line 1791, in dispatch_request: return self.ensure_sync(self.view_functions[rule.endpoint])(**req.view_args). The abort / error handling flow lives in flask/app.py.

cases.title: ResponseCacheControl.s_maxage raises error when set to an int
cases.issue: Bug: assigning response.cache_control.s_maxage = 60 raises TypeError: argument of type int is not iterable. Traceback (most recent call last): File 'werkzeug/datastructures.py', line 2039, in _set_cache_value. File 'werkzeug/datastructures.py', line 1958, in cache_control_property setter lambda. TypeError: argument of type int is not iterable. The _CacheControl._set_cache_value in werkzeug datastructures cache_control should coerce int values to str.

cases.title: DechunkedInput.read returns more than what was asked for
cases.issue: Bug: werkzeug.serving.DechunkedInput.read(n) can return more than n bytes when consuming a chunked request body, violating the wsgi.input_stream contract from PEP 3333. The chunked buffering logic in DechunkedInput.read / readinto in werkzeug/serving.py does not respect the requested size; see serving.py line 105.

cases.title: config.from_pyfile crashes on Python 3
cases.issue: Bug: app.config.from_pyfile('settings.cfg') crashes with UnicodeDecodeError: ascii codec can't decode byte on Python 3 when the config file contains non-ASCII text. flask/config.py from_pyfile opens the file with the default locale encoding and then runs exec(compile(config_file.read(), filename, 'exec'), d.__dict__). It should open the file as UTF-8.

cases.title: Markup.__init__ causes error
cases.issue: Bug: rendering a template value raises TypeError coming from the Markup subclass defined in jinja2/utils.py (see jinja2/utils.py line 843). Markup.__init__ / escape in jinja2/utils.py fails for objects that do not implement __html__ and are not plain strings.
